rationale: Ground truth is thin (one inline ask to verify reduce_scatter in the test), and X engages it most directly by showing those new hasattr assertions test the mock's own injected attributes rather than the real fix — a sharper version of the reviewer's concern. X also surfaces substantive, diff-grounded correctness risks (DP-metadata gating not tied to the MoE mapping, a plausible CFG-parallel hang, missing data_parallel_rank, dead branch/dtype nit) with concrete, minimal fixes. Y's findings are mostly test-coverage suggestions rather than bugs, are partly redundant across its 'Validated'/'general' sections, and its suggested test snippets are incomplete (undefined mocks), making it less actionable and lower-value overall.
